groups.saying_opens: ضعف حكيم بن جبير وعبد الأعلى
إذا قدمت على جرير فاكتب علمه

notes: Two sayings with their own isnads (rule 4a). Saying 1 is Yahya b. Sa'id al-Qattan's criticism of named transmitters (سمعت يحيى). Saying 2 is Ibn al-Mubarak's advice, relayed by Hasan b. Isa (قال لي ابن المبارك). Both begin at Bishr b. al-Hakam.
Muslim's own remark (قال مسلم وأشباه) is not a chain. The later «ومن ذهب في العلم» passage is his comment, also not a chain.
